rows.grounds: correlative particle with emphatic particle fused
compound denoting giving of a disciple

items.question: In what manner must the gift of a disciple be presented to that recipient?
premises: A prior situation establishes a standard of response.
The same manner applies to that specified recipient.
The giving of a disciple is constituted as an offering.
items.inference: Therefore the disciple must be given to that recipient as an offering in the same manner.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tasmai depends on the preceding verses.
The specific prior action indicated by yathā is supplied by context.
items.plain_english: Just as before, so indeed to him the giving of the disciple is to be made as an offering.
